package.name: optimized_apf
package.description: Optimized artificial potential field local obstacle avoidance for mowing robots. Core ported from artificial_potential_fields0 (APF_unomni), with fixes: yaw P-control, parameterized speed-adaptive gain, emergency-stop hysteresis, output slew-rate smoothing, low-speed and position-progress stall detection, repulsion-aware local-minimum escape, fail-safe input timeouts, avoidance travel-distance reporting and persistent-blockage replan request.
